_comment: Golden retrieval queries against the LIVE vault. Positive queries phrase a question the way an agent would, and expect_any lists path substrings that count as a hit. Negative queries describe topics that do NOT exist in the vault; anything scoring above recall_min_score is a false injection. Maintenance: when a golden note is archived or superseded, update expect_any to the successor note instead of deleting the query. Add roughly 2 new positive queries per month from real recall misses you noticed. Keep queries phrased as natural prompts, not keyword soup.

positive.query: how should we store bearer tokens that appear in URLs
postgres row level security enable force without policies
what status code should a proxy return when upstream fails with 5xx
why do posthog funnels underreport anonymous user conversion
agenticfootball ecs task iam permissions for sqs queues
how to publish an mcp server to the registry
memento installer remembering flags between upgrades
css grid child column span instead of changing parent grid
should tone rules live in skills or in memory
should workflow checkpoints and plan artifacts be committed to git

negative.query: kafka consumer group rebalancing strategy for the payments cluster
tuning the rust garbage collector nursery size
istio sidecar mtls certificate rotation in the staging mesh
stm32 dma double buffering for the motor controller firmware
